rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=100, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-20 SIX-BOX (FINAL). (1) PRIOR: iter-19 hr=0.0, n_iter=25 extreme early-stop gave rmse=0.00633 -- freezing near the warm-start init did NOT beat baseline; the init is itself over-smoothed. The full inner-step sweep (25/50/100/200/400 -> 0.00633/0.00628/0.00627/0.00633/0.00623) is FLAT within ~3%, all hr=0. Iters 1-19 ALL hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I converges to the over-smoothed FBP-consistent plateau on dense 128-view breast; it has NO edge-preserving structural guard, unlike the bilateral sibling (dual_domain_bilateral_n2i) whose tight range kernel reached hr~0.21. This is the DOCUMENTED structural ceiling (docs/findings.md: N2I over-smooths dense breast at 128 views because the FBP self-supervision target is itself a poor supervision signal). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-19 (n_iter=25), n_iter 25 -> 100 -- returns to the best-rmse inner-step count (iter-10, rmse=0.00627) as a CONFIRMATORY closing replicate of the best-found config at full val_n=200. (4) HYPOTHESIS: this reproduces iter-10's ~0.00627 rmse at hr=0, confirming the best config the search found still cannot beat the sparse-FBP baseline -- a clean final datapoint that the ceiling is genuine and config-robust, not a missed lever. (5) BUDGET: n_iter=100 + pretrain ep=3 + figure ~= 16 min < 30-min wall. (6) FINAL iter -- loop ends here (20 valid six-box iters). Ceiling documented across 20 genuinely different levers: budget, per-scene fit, capacity (up/down), warm-start (off/1/3/10 ep/steps-cap/batch), lr (1e-4..3e-3), grad_clip, seed, inner-steps (25..400). Every one hr=0.
